title: Home Purchase Financing Escrow Account Disclosure — Disbursements, Surplus Refunds and Payoff
content:
**Escrow account terms for Home Purchase Financing loans whose hazard-insurance premiums are escrowed**

**Paying premiums.** Escrowed premiums are paid from escrow when the insurer bills them, even if escrow must be advanced below zero to do so.

**Analysis and projection — retired clause.** *"The escrow is analyzed every number of months the program sets between analyses: the projected disbursements are the next 12 months of premium (the newest premium paid from escrow to the borrower's own insurer), the target low point is the program's cushion months of those disbursements, and the projected low balance is compared with it." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as a record.*

**Shortage spread and new deposit — retired clause.** *"A shortage — the target low point less the projected low balance — is spread over the program's shortage-spread installments; the new monthly escrow is the projected premium divided by 12 plus the shortage divided by the program's shortage-spread installments, rounded half up to the cent, from the first installment due after the analysis." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as a record.*

**Surplus.** A surplus of at least the program's surplus refund threshold is refunded within the program's surplus refund days in calendar days; a smaller surplus stays in escrow and lowers the next year's deposit. A surplus is refunded only when the loan is active (not delinquent) on the analysis date; otherwise it stays in escrow.

**After payoff.** After payoff, the whole escrow balance is refunded to the borrower.

### Surplus outcomes (hypothetical, a refund threshold taken as 50.00)

| Surplus found | Loan status on the analysis date | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 120.00 | active | refunded within the refund period |
| 120.00 | delinquent | stays in escrow |
| 30.00 | active | stays in escrow and lowers the next year's deposit |

superseded_clauses: The escrow is analyzed every escrow_analysis_interval_months: the projected disbursements are the next 12 months of premium (loan_msr_projected_premium), the target low point is escrow_cushion_months of those disbursements, and the projected low balance is compared with it.

A shortage — the target low point less the projected low balance — is spread over escrow_shortage_spread_months installments; the new monthly escrow is the projected premium divided by 12 plus the shortage divided by escrow_shortage_spread_months, rounded half up to the cent, from the first installment due after the analysis.
